We have mass spec m/z 224.1201 (M+?), likely molecular ion. So molecular weight ~224.12. Carbon NMR shows many aromatic carbons: many around 128-129, plus carbonyl at 196.8, plus some aliphatic carbons at 37.5, 36.39, 26.41. So likely a phenyl ketone with alkyl chain.

The candidate SMILES we validated: "CCCc1ccc(cc1)C(=O)c2ccccc2". Let's compute formula and mass. Use get_formula? Let's compute via tool.
